contradicting_evidence: Current downside evidence is coherent: weak breadth, ETH-relative losses, negative aggressive spot flow and contracting stablecoin supply could persist beyond the shorter horizons.
There is no observed broad bullish transmission to balance the bearish cross-section. NO_EDGE therefore does not mean normal downside risk or an established trading range.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Week-long net direction is unresolved. Failed rebounds and renewed retests remain credible, but BTC stabilization could interrupt the decline. Neither durable recovery nor persistent contraction is established well enough to select a directional endpoint.
falsification_conditions: Repeated multi-session declines across BTC and ETH, persistent ETH/BTC weakness, continued poor participation and additional adverse settled flows would resolve the outlook toward DOWN.
A sustained multi-session recovery accompanied by stronger ETH/BTC, broader participation and improving settled flows would resolve the outlook toward UP.
BTC-only resilience, isolated altcoin winners or a single breadth rebound would not resolve the broad-market uncertainty.
missing_evidence: A multi-session sequence of price, relative-strength and breadth observations is needed to establish persistence beyond the current shock.
Additional settled BTC and ETH ETF sessions and updated stablecoin supply observations are needed to test whether funding conditions improve or deteriorate.
Broader small-cap and microcap observations remain unavailable, preventing a complete transmission assessment.
supporting_evidence: Positive settled BTC flows conflict with ETH outflows, shrinking stablecoin supply and broad price weakness; these do not establish a uniform market-wide demand regime.
BTC's bid-heavy depth snapshot coexists with negative taker flow. Absorption versus recovery remains unresolved.
The evidence establishes an acute selloff and weak participation, but not its persistence over a full week. Slow contextual observations cannot supply the missing forward path.
The transmission state reflects currently deteriorating observed proxies, not a confirmed canonical rotation assessment or a prediction that deterioration must last all week.
